primary_goal: Guide visitors to browse product categories, discover seasonal campaigns (Weihnachtswelt), and add trending or recommended items to their cart.

friction_points.issue: Primary Hero call-to-action is rendered as a subtle text link rather than a prominent visual button.
friction_points.evidence: In the top hero banner, the main call to action is formatted as text '-> Zu unserer Weihnachtswelt' inside a white box, making it lack visual weight compared to standard high-converting primary buttons.

friction_points.issue: Product cards use small, icon-only cart buttons without explicit text, increasing cognitive effort to add items to cart directly.
friction_points.evidence: In the 'Neu im Sortiment' product carousel, items have a small dark blue circle with a white shopping cart icon rather than a clear 'In den Warenkorb' button.

friction_points.issue: Key German payment methods (Klarna, PayPal, Rechnung) and trust badges (EHI) are buried at the bottom of the long page footer.
friction_points.evidence: Logos for Klarna, PayPal, Vorkasse, and EHI 'Geprüfter Online-Shop' appear only in image 9, deep in the footer section.

friction_points.issue: Excessive SEO text blocks and stacked accordions at the bottom of the page create visual clutter and lengthen the page unnecessarily.
friction_points.evidence: Images 6, 7, and 8 contain long paragraphs under 'Vorteile Deiner Onlinebestellung' and numerous expanded/collapsible category accordion links.

hypotheses.hypothesis: If we transform the Hero banner text link into a high-contrast primary CTA button ('Jetzt Weihnachtswelt entdecken'), then the hero click-through rate will increase because it creates a clear visual hierarchy and focus.
hypotheses.change: Replace text link '-> Zu unserer Weihnachtswelt' in the hero card with a prominent, high-contrast action button.

hypotheses.hypothesis: If we replace the small cart icon on product recommendation cards with a full-width 'In den Warenkorb' button, then direct add-to-cart rates from the homepage will increase because shoppers won't hesitate over icon functionality.
hypotheses.change: Add explicit button text 'In den Warenkorb' to product cards in 'Neu im Sortiment'.

hypotheses.hypothesis: If we display key payment icons (Klarna Kauf auf Rechnung, PayPal) and 2-hour store pickup USPs directly below the main hero slider, then session-to-checkout conversion will improve because trust and convenience are established immediately.
hypotheses.change: Add a prominent USP bar below the hero featuring PayPal/Klarna logos and Express-Abholung highlights.

quick_wins: Style the text link '-> Zu unserer Weihnachtswelt' in the hero section to look like a clickable primary button.
Ensure contrast on secondary image text links across seasonal banners is improved for readability.
uncertainties: Auto-rotation speed and interaction rates of the main hero slider carousel across devices.
Distribution of desktop vs. mobile traffic for dm.de homepage.
